topics.title: Portugal starts Lisbon-Porto high-speed rail work
topics.summary: Portugal began construction on the first section of its high-speed rail line linking Lisbon and Porto, with work starting between Porto-Campanhã and Oiã.[1] The government said the line is intended to cut the trip between the two cities to 1 hour and 15 minutes when completed.[1]
topics.detail: The section under construction is 71 kilometres long and includes a new road-rail bridge over the Douro River, a new station at Vila Nova de Gaia-Santo Ovídio, and an expansion of Porto-Campanhã Intermodal Station.[1] The government said the concession contract for the section will cost around €2 billion.[1] It said the project includes €875 million in European Investment Bank financing and €480 million from the Connecting Europe Facility.[1]

sources.title: Portugal begins high-speed rail construction between Lisbon and Porto

topics.title: Study links healthier coral reefs to seabird colonies
topics.summary: A report said coral reefs near seabird colonies are generally healthier because birds deposit nutrients in guano.[2] The piece said the finding points to a direct link between seabird restoration and reef recovery.[2]
topics.detail: The article focused on reefs near Palmyra Atoll and described birds as a "secret weapon" for reef health.[2] It said the nutrient input from seabirds helps support the surrounding reef ecosystem.[2]

sources.title: Some of the most pristine coral reefs have a secret weapon: birds

topics.title: Formula 1 enters a scheduled break after Singapore
topics.summary: Coverage from the week said Formula 1 is on a scheduled weekend off after the Singapore Grand Prix.[3][4] The next race is set for October 23-25 at Circuit of The Americas in Austin, Texas.[3][4]
topics.detail: One report described the sport’s calendar as a regionalized schedule with a European midseason and races in Asia, the Americas and Australia around it.[4] Another item from the official F1 site listed the 2026 calendar and showed the Singapore round in the October 9-11 slot.[3]
